resources.string: Backend disconnected. Pull down to reconnect.
The local OpenCode server did not start. Check the inference endpoint settings, then retry.
Connect the app to your own inference endpoint. Everything runs against your server — no third-party services.
Your key is stored encrypted on this device only. The backend binds to 127.0.0.1 and never accepts external connections.
Tap the field to load the list from your endpoint
The endpoint listed no models — type the id manually
Fill in the base URL and API key first
Typing is still allowed: you can pick an id the endpoint does not list.
Choose whether this device runs its own agent or mirrors a home OpenCode server. Pairing is optional — the local agent needs no server of anyone else\'s.
No servers paired yet. Scan a pairing QR or paste a pairing link.
Working locally. Nothing is mirrored; the backend runs only this device\'s sessions.
Following %1$s. Its sessions stream into this app live.
The local agent stops mirroring the home server and runs only this device. The pairing is kept, so you can resume following without pairing again.
Switched to the local agent. Restarting the backend…
Used only to scan the QR code that `opencode pair` prints. Nothing is recorded or stored.
Camera permission is turned off for this app, so the scanner cannot open. You can enable it in system settings, or just paste the pairing link — the camera is optional.

Huawei, Xiaomi and similar ROMs freeze background apps to save battery, which stops the local OpenCode server while it is supposed to be running. Allow unrestricted background activity for this app. On HarmonyOS/EMUI also open Battery → App launch and set OpenCode to “Manage manually”.
Diagnostics copied — paste it wherever you are reporting the issue
The OpenCode server is downloaded rather than packed into the app, which keeps app updates small. It is fetched once and only re-downloaded when it actually changes.
Checking the runtime already on disk…
A newer backend runtime is available: %1$s
Could not reach the runtime manifest. Check the connection, then retry.
No runtime installed, so the backend cannot start. Download it from this screen whenever you are ready.

Binds the backend to all interfaces and opens a remote shell endpoint for a machine on the same tailnet. Everything here is reachable with the token below — leave it off unless you are actively debugging.
Off. Backend binds 127.0.0.1, no exec endpoint.
On. Backend binds 0.0.0.0, exec endpoint live.
New token is shown above. Restart the backend to apply it.
